_purpose: Deterministic classification of existing corpus documents into competencies. These are rules, not content. A document that no rule claims is reported unmapped - never guessed.
_method: Multi-label. Every matching signal scores. The highest scorer becomes the PRIMARY competency if it leads by the win margin; anything at or above the secondary floor is also taught by the unit. A document no rule claims is reported unmapped.
_why_multi_label: AI_LAB_UNIVERSITY.md: 'The same unit may appear in several tracks.' Tags describe where a failure happened; a competency describes what it teaches. A Gemini rate-limit incident teaches Integrating (handle every branch) and Operating (detect and diagnose) at once. Single-label assignment starved Operating to zero, which would have made graduation impossible, since Operating is mandatory.

structural._note: Rules that do not depend on tags. Tag vocabulary describes the technology a failure occurred in, so a discipline like Operating is invisible to it - the corpus tags a production outage as 'firebase', never as 'incident response'.

operating.rule: Any resolved production incident carrying a severity teaches Operating - detection, diagnosis and write-up are what the incident record IS, independent of the technology it happened in.
operating._primary_justification: A high-severity production failure is first an operations lesson and second a lesson about the tool it happened in.

beat_sources._note: Which corpus folder supplies which beat of the Incident -> Principle -> Practice -> Proof model.

incident.note: 20 documented production failures with symptoms, root causes and fixes. An asset accumulated, not authored.

principle.note: The generalisable rule the incident reveals. Must be authored per unit; the engine reports which units lack one rather than inventing it.

practice.note: The reproduction task. The student causes the failure deliberately, then fixes it.

proof.note: The student's own deployed artefact. Not a corpus document - produced by the project engine.

system_aliases._note: The `project` field is inconsistent across the corpus. Normalised here rather than edited in 20 files.
